finalText:
**Migration done in 12 files, 36 call sites.** All now use `db.execute({ sql, params })`. `node --check` passes on every file.

Two `db.query` calls remain in [vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js:9](vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js:9). I left them alone. Its header says do not edit, since upgrades overwrite local changes.

`cache.query` is a separate API. I did not touch it.

Next: decide the vendor call sites. Options are wrapping `findAll`/`findOne` or pinning the driver.
